tasks.name: 03-side-menu
tasks.js: () => { const out = []; const seen = new Set(); document.querySelectorAll('.el-menu-item, .el-submenu__title, aside *, [class*="side"] *, [class*="menu"] *').forEach(el => { const t = (el.textContent||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim(); if (t && t.length > 1 && t.length < 20 && el.children.length < 5 && !seen.has(t)) { seen.add(t); out.push({ tag: el.tagName, cls: String(el.className).slice(0,50), text: t }) } }); return out.slice(0, 200) }
